attrs.label: Tailscale Credentials
attrs.description:
Credentials DockTail uses to create service definitions in your tailnet.</br>
OAuth is recommended because API keys expire.</br>
Without credentials, you create each service in the Tailscale admin console yourself.</br>
Setup and required permissions: https://docktail.org/docs/tailscale-admin/

enum.description: None (Create services manually in the Tailscale admin console)

1.0.0.readme:
DockTail

DockTail turns Docker containers with docktail labels into Tailscale Services.

!!! WARNING !!!

This application requires additional elevated permissions beyond standard containerization protections. Use at your own risk.

The following additional privileges may be enabled from installing this application:

• Docker Socket Access

• Host Networking
